newsitem.title: USA: Strategic Distribution Inc names Sergey CFO.
newsitem.headline: Strategic Distribution Inc names Sergey CFO.

text.p: Strategic Distribution Inc said Monday John Sergey was named the new president, chief executive officer and director of the company.
The company also said Michael F. Devine III was named chief financial officer and treasurer.
The company said Sergey's appointment will be effective May 1, and Devine's new job is effective immediately.
Sergey was previously president and CEO of GAF Materials Corp. Deevine was the chief financial officer of Strategic's In-Plant Store subsidiary.
The company said Sergey will replace Theodore Rieple, who, as previously announced, resigned his position.
